events.summary: Lathril, queen of the ancient Einir, left a powerful legacy for her mortal descendants.
events.quote: Lathril, queen of the ancient Einir, left a powerful legacy for her mortal descendants.

events.summary: Heliod placed the sun into the hand of the Champion, as told in The Theriad.
events.quote: The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.

events.summary: Agnur learned that the spirits' blades were solid and razor-sharp.
events.quote: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

events.summary: The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting scorn poles, which a herd crushed in seconds.
events.quote: The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.

events.summary: Olka collected evening mist for years and learned to vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets.

events.summary: Nissa Revane tells Dwynen she has already seen so much evil and darkness.
events.quote: "I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"

events.summary: Ob Nixilis recounts conquering world after world, his power growing each time.
events.quote: My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier.
